title: unified-rollouts: enhance canary/A-B/shadow autorollback workflows and observability
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: customers running production canary and shadow rollouts have asked for more robust automated rollback behavior when multiple signal types disagree (latency regressions vs quality regressions) and better per-stage observability to reason about rollouts. This PR refactors the autorollback engine to support composite metric thresholds, per-stage quarantine, and explicit A/B weight adjustment rules so that canary, A/B, and shadow deployments share one consistent lifecycle.

What this changes: - Refactor: split autorollback evaluator (metrics -> decision) from executor (actuate weight/fallback). This makes it easier to add new decision heuristics and to simulate decisions without flipping live traffic. - Composite metrics: allow defining a rule that combines latency, error-rate, and quality-eval score with configurable weights and dynamic thresholds. - Quarantine stage: if a stage trips a soft-threshold, it is quarantined (traffic frozen) for a probing window rather than immediately rolled back; probing policies can be manual or automatic with quorum. - Shadow probing improvements: proactive shadow probing now supports staged probing with adjustable probe durations and mirrored request sampling to reduce noise. - Observability: added rollouts.* and autorollback.* metrics (decision_reason, composite_score, quarantine_count, probe_success_rate) plus per-rollout traces for timeline visualization in the Console. - E2E and unit tests: added e2e scenarios for weighted canary -> quarantine -> rollback and A/B split adjustments. - Migration: existing rollout manifests without composite rules continue to behave as before; new schema fields are optional.

Testing and validation: - Local unit test suite and integration harness run on CI. - Added deterministic simulation harness (rollout-sim) that validates decision behavior against historical traffic traces (included sample traces under rollouts/testdata). - Ran a staged rollout internally against the perf-canary lab (1000s of simulated requests) to validate latency gating behavior.

Rollout plan: merge to main, enable feature-flagged rollout on staging, run 48h soak with production-like traces, then enable by default for customers on Dedicated with opt-in for Hosted.

Checklist: - [x] Refactor evaluator/executor - [x] Composite metric implementation - [x] Quarantine stage and probing - [x] Observability metrics and tracing hooks - [x] Unit + e2e tests - [x] Docs update: docs/unified-rollouts.md

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps the default behavior unchanged for existing rollouts; new behavior is gated by a rollout.policy.composite_rules field. See docs/unified-rollouts.md for examples and Linear ENG-2143 for decision rationale.
